[P1] Validate ReplayChildren branches recorded as STARTED

This validation covers terminal reconstruction, but `replay()` returns indexes in `record.started_indexes` without inspecting their checkpoint. An existing NESTED STARTED container can therefore replay in FLAT mode—or with a changed branch name—without raising nondeterminism. Load and validate the derived checkpoint for recorded STARTED indexes too; permit a missing checkpoint in NESTED mode because a submitted worker may not have begun, and add named-branch and NESTED-to-FLAT tests.
